status: Art-approved texture deformation contract; runtime and visual verification pending

fixed_base.motion: None. Preserve original opaque silhouette and floor registration.

windup_motion.duration_authority: Existing runtime windup duration; normalize elapsed to0..1
windup_motion.deformation: Continuous horizontal pressure tremor on upper texture. Multiply displacement by clamp((390-source_local_y)/90,0,1), so it is exactly zero at the fixed-base seam. Render textured mesh or narrow contiguous strips; do not translate a detached upper rectangle.
windup_motion.brightness_rule: Ramp upper charge artwork brightness with normalized progress and restrained sine pulse; retain original purple eyes/nozzle. This is brightness buildup, not a claimed rotating gauge-needle animation.
windup_motion.clock: Continuous elapsed seconds, no per-frame random jitter or 0.3s pose switching.

recoil.rule: Apply the same seam-pinned deformation to fire frame; recoil opposite muzzle direction, ease back to zero. Base stays fixed. Existing recovery frame4 follows with existing foot registration.

validation_required: Base and seam remain joined during entire windup and recoil
Pressure motion visible at normal gameplay size without whole-object skating
Muzzle position matches projectile emission at fire boundary
No change to damage, attack duration, range or audio
Capture actual runtime before claiming completed animation
